title: .omne/skill.json
description: The declarations of a Skill package, format version 1. The behavior owner is SPEC.md of @omne-harness/skill-contract. Lengths count Unicode code points. The parser rejects these documents, and this schema does not express the rule: a formatVersion written as 1.0 or 1e0 (the lexeme must be 1); a script entry made of . segments only; a text with a lone surrogate; a repeated key; a byte order mark; bytes that are not UTF-8; a document over the JSON budget; a script entry that is not a file of the package or is a control file; script entries that repeat after . segments are removed; setting names that repeat.

formatVersion.description: The number 1, written with the lexeme 1. Any other value is declaration-format-unsupported.

dependencies.description: Required tools. An absent list is an empty list.

scripts.description: Script declarations. An absent list is an empty list.

entry.description: A relative path inside the package. No leading slash, no backslash, no empty segment, no .. segment, no control character.

runKind.description: Skill does not interpret the run kind.

facilities.description: Facility names. Skill does not check whether a facility is present.

parameters.description: The parameter shape. Any JSON value, kept as it was read.

settings.description: Setting declarations: names and categories, never values. An absent list is an empty list.
